## Apply the power to every factor {#product}

When the whole product is in brackets, apply the fractional power to the coefficient and the variable.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$(27x^6)^{\frac13}$

::: {.fragment}

[Apply the exponent to both factors.]{.annotation}

$=27^{\frac13}x^{6\times\frac13}$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Take the cube root of 27 and simplify the index.]{.annotation}

$=3x^2$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$(27x^6)^{\frac23}$

The root stays the same. Use the cube root on the left, then square the entire result.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=(\sqrt[3]{27x^6})^2$

$=(3x^2)^2=9x^4$

:::
